result.title: Meta-Amortized Cognitive Modeling
result.summary: Cognitive modeling is highly iterative. Researchers repeatedly revise model structures, parameterizations, covariates, and experimental designs as theories evolve and data accumulates. Amortized Bayesian inference with neural networks provides rapid estimation for individual models, but every revision requires new simulations and training. Here, we introduce CogFormerV2, a meta-amortized framework that enables researchers to specify, revise, and fit cognitive models with a single network, carrying amortization across an entire space of models all at once. Trained once in about a day on a single GPU, it delivers accurate, well-calibrated posteriors across more than 14.6 billion model configurations spanning binary, multi-alternative, and continuous decisions, with varying parameter sets, covariate structures, trial counts, and contamination levels. It can fit empirical data from distinct behavioral tasks and extends to new models through continual learning and representation transfer. Released as an open-source interactive application, CogFormerV2 provides a reusable infrastructure for meta-amortized inference in cognitive modeling, while carrying the potential to accelerate computational modeling workflows at large.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CogFormerV2：一个元摊销贝叶斯推断框架，用单一网络一次训练（单 GPU 约一天）即可对跨越 146 亿种配置的认知模型空间给出校准良好的后验，并支持持续学习扩展到新模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 跨模型空间的摊销后验估计与表示迁移，可能为 LVR 中同时维护多种 latent 假设并为假设分配概率、以及在结构或配置变化时复用推理计算提供概念线索，具体机制可供核查。
